id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description: optional descriptor, i.e. every monday 9-5 or first monday of the month

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

calendarUnit.description: recurring base calendar unit monthly, weekly, daily, annually

onQualifier.description:
Allows picking a day of week by month or year
i.e. ON last Thursday of the month

startTime.description:
start window of time during the day described by the rule, inclusive
00:00 to 00:00 means no work hours  HH:MM - will change to time datatype
HH:MM - will change to time datatype

endTime.description:
end window of time during the day described by the rule, exclusive
null implies unbounded in context of the day (end of day)
HH:MM - will change to time datatype

effectiveDate.description:
date range of when this rule is in effect for a schedule
inclusive

title:
Settings to define a recurring day and optional window of time
Allows multiple time windows for a day to support a restaurant that may close in
the afternoon for a few hours or a business that takes a siesta
May define normal work hours for a day of week Mon-Sun (i.e. when a facility is occupied)
00:00 to 00:00 means no hours  00:00 to null means all 24 hours of the day
Business Key: all core attributes, not meaningful to enforce
name: ScheduleRecurringDayRule
